blocks.text: Grammy® Award-winning, multi-platinum global superstar Miley has released her highly anticipated tenth studio album, Bass Persuades, via Atlantic Records – available now on all streaming platforms HERE. Anchored by the lead single and title track,“Bass Persuades,” which quickly became the #1 Most Added Overall Song at US Radio and dominated global debuts at #1 on the US Spotify Top Songs chart and #2 globally, the album’s release is accompanied by the official music video for “Let’s Get Married.” Directed by Mert Alas and filmed at the iconic Chateau Marmont, the visual features Miley’s fiancé, Maxx Morando – watch HERE.
